test_parse_mutants: test the parse_mutants function to parse comma-delimited mutation strings into sorted tuples
test_introduces_stop_codon: test the introduces_stop_codon function to check if any mutation introduces a stop codon
test_mutates_stop_codon: test the mutates_stop_codon function to check if any mutation mutates an existing stop codon
test_apply_mutations_to_parent: test the apply_mutations_to_parent function to apply mutation tuples to a parent protein sequence
test_data_utils: test the data_utils module functions for parsing and applying protein mutations
